description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that inspects the actual trained GRU4Rec model and produces measured metrics, metric definitions, and an interpretation prompt. Diagnostics inform model revisions; selection uses macro-average validation HR@10 across all four Amazon categories.
motivation: Make model improvement depend on reproducible observations while preserving the benchmark, GRU4Rec backbone, and single-model-per-category constraint. Explicit metric definitions help prevent unsupported interpretations of unavailable data or user traits.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Preserve ModelView interfaces: model, item_emb, log2feats, predict_score, user_train, meta_data, and review_data. Handle loader batches as (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B×L tensors. For left-padded histories, use the final nonpadding position rather than count−1. Compute diagnostics only from actual model outputs and available histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; report unsupported measurements as unavailable. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Keep one trained checkpoint per category and synchronize any architecture changes with the embedded predictor writer. Preserve seeds, splits, dataset routing, and the fixed host evaluator.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        remember model training state
        put view.model in evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
                validate shapes and padding masks
                features = view.log2feats(sequence)
                compute supported diagnostics through family-compatible interfaces
                aggregate measurements over valid observations
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_values, metric_definitions: definitions}

diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    identify unavailable evidence explicitly
    request GRU4Rec-compatible, single-model improvement hypotheses
    distinguish observations from hypotheses
    return prompt

originality.positive: Connects family-specific model inspection with explicit evidence definitions and constrained iterative improvement.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration contract; the description introduces no new diagnostic estimator or learning algorithm. Score is a qualitative assessment on a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Could support targeted architecture and optimization experiments with interpretable, reproducible diagnostics.
future_potential.negative: Diagnostic usefulness and correlation with validation improvements remain un demonstrated; unavailable attributes limit behavioral conclusions. Score is qualitative, on a 1–10 scale.

code_difficulty.positive: Existing ModelView interfaces and a fixed batch format provide clear integration points.
code_difficulty.negative: Requires careful handling of padding, feature shapes, measurement aggregation, model state, and checkpoint–predictor consistency. Score denotes implementation difficulty on a 1–10 scale.
